steps.en: Enable it in your repo and pick your agents
steps.zh: 在仓库里启用并选好 agent

steps.en: Captures prompts, tool calls and files as the agent works
steps.zh: agent 干活时捕获提示、工具调用与文件改动

steps.en: Commit as usual — the trailer links your commit to the record
steps.zh: 照常 commit — trailer 把你的 commit 链到记录上

steps.en: Condenses the session into a checkpoint ref in the git object store
steps.zh: 把会话浓缩成 git 对象库里的 checkpoint ref

steps.en: Resume a stopped session from the last checkpoint
steps.zh: 从最近一次 checkpoint 恢复停掉的会话

value.en: A searchable, per-commit record of how the code was written — outside your branch history — with a known-good checkpoint to resume from
value.zh: 分支历史之外，一份连着 commit、可搜索的编码过程记录，和可恢复的已知良好 checkpoint
